# BUYER-SUPPLIER AGREEMENT

**This Agreement is made on ________ (Date) at ________ (City).**

**BETWEEN**

**[Supplier Name]**, a company/firm incorporated under the laws of India, having its principal place of business at [Supplier Address], holding Udyam Registration Number [Supplier Udyam/MSME No.] and GSTIN [Supplier GSTIN] (hereinafter referred to as the "Supplier").

**AND**

**[Buyer Name]**, a company/firm incorporated under the laws of India, having its principal place of business at [Buyer Address], holding GSTIN [Buyer GSTIN] (hereinafter referred to as the "Buyer").

## 1. Scope of Agreement
The Supplier agrees to sell, and the Buyer agrees to purchase, goods/services as per the Purchase Orders raised from time to time, subject to the terms and conditions outlined in this Agreement.

## 2. Payment Terms & MSME Compliance
The Buyer shall make payment for goods supplied or services rendered by the Supplier on or before 45 days from the date of acceptance or deemed acceptance of such goods or services, in accordance with the provisions of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (MSMED) Act, 2006.

**Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement or any Purchase Order, the payment period shall in no event exceed 45 days from the date of acceptance/deemed acceptance of goods or services, as mandated under Section 15 of the MSMED Act, 2006.**

Any delay in payment beyond the stipulated timeline shall attract compound interest with monthly rests to the supplier at three times the bank rate notified by the Reserve Bank of India, as specified under Section 16 of the MSMED Act, 2006.

Furthermore, failure to make payment within the 45-day period will render the purchase amount ineligible for tax deduction in the current financial year for the Buyer, under Section 43B(h) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

## 3. Acceptance of Goods
The Buyer must inspect the goods/services upon delivery. Any objection regarding the quality or quantity of goods/services must be raised in writing within 15 days from the date of delivery. If no objection is raised within 15 days, it shall be deemed that the goods/services have been accepted ("Deemed Acceptance").

## 4. General Provisions
- **Jurisdiction:** Any disputes arising out of this agreement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts at [Supplier City].
- **Termination:** This agreement may be terminated by either party by giving a 30-day written notice.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the parties have signed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
